Jaipur Police Parade Murder Accused After Laborer's Killing

Jaipur police paraded three individuals accused of murder through a market, with one of the accused seen limping. The accused were involved in the killing of a laborer in Jaipur. The incident has left the victim's three young children fatherless. The accused are currently in police remand.
